resources.string: JPEG / JPG only • Zero storage permissions
Unsupported file type. Only JPEG / JPG files are supported.
Saved photo contains only your edited metadata. No original data was kept inside it.
The backup file contains your old location, dates and text. Store it privately or don\'t create it.
In \"Don\'t keep any backup\" mode, original bytes are held only in memory for \"Revert to original\" during this session and are discarded on \"Clear session\" or exit.

All metadata marked for removal. Applying changes will strip every EXIF, XMP, IPTC, comment, thumbnail, and trailing payload (keeping only JFIF, ICC profile, and Adobe APP14). Use Revert to original to undo.
